rationale: The cited 95/155 contains nqəlla with two apples thrown at the women’s heads, not nqəlle ruḥe “er stürzte sich auf”. summary: Stem I sense 3 contains both an overt projectile (apple) and ruḥayye as a self-directed object in collision. The existing examples establish the uses but do not require a rewritten gloss from these few tokens.

Detransitive nqīr with b-target is semantically directed motion/contact, with the moving Theotokos as subject, rather than a patient acted upon by an agent. A numbered gloss is supplied for its existing unnumbered section; the two corpus tokens are already quoted.
